listings.title: 1974 Volkswagen Thing
listings.ceiling: Stop around $19k hammer / about $20k with fee
listings.why: Open-air, charming, simple, and directly aligned with a beach-town family runabout profile.
listings.concerns: Verify rust, seat belts, weather gear, title status, and whether the rear seating works for the intended passengers.

dossier.summary: Two-owner Thing in Texas Yellow over black, with a recent top, fresh brakes, and a clean South Carolina title.
listing: This 1974 Volkswagen Thing is finished in Texas Yellow over a black interior and is powered by a 1.6-liter flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle.
Work under current ownership includes a new soft top, a front-end refresh, fresh brake hydraulics, and a carburetor rebuild. The doors are removable and the windshield folds.
The car is offered with a clean South Carolina title, a tool roll, and a binder of receipts. The seller notes minor surface rust on the floor pans and a small tear in the driver's seat.

comments.body: Floors look honest in the extra photos. GLWTA.
Top frame is complete and the new canvas fits well.

listings.title: 1981 Honda CT110 Trail
listings.ceiling: Stop around $4.5k hammer / about $4.7k with fee
listings.why: Small, approachable, useful for quick town errands, and much easier than a full-size ADV bike.
listings.concerns: Confirm title/registration, cold start, charging system, tire age, and local-road comfort.
